name: BarChart
label: Bar chart
description: Vertical bars for comparing values across categories or time, with summary stats and tooltips.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the values, tooltips and value axis are written in, such as `de-DE`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: xKey
props.description: Key in data for x-axis values

props.name: yKey
props.description: Key in data for y-axis values

props.name: dataLabel
props.description: Display name for the data series (shown in tooltip)

props.name: title
props.description:
Chart title, in the shared chart header; it also names the figure.
Note: this replaces the native `title` tooltip attribute, which the chart does not expose.

props.name: summaryItems
props.description: Summary stats displayed in the header

props.name: barColor
props.description: Bar fill colour — CSS value or token reference

props.name: bare
props.description: Strip the card chrome (border, padding, fill) when the chart sits inside another panel that supplies the surface

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the wrapper
